households.demographics: not represented; no age or eligibility inference

resident_trips.selection: select size-4 parties from distinct households of size>=4; then pairs from unused size>=2 households; then singles from unused households; no person reused
resident_trips.within_bin_departure_rule: uniform independent draws followed by stable time/ID sorting
resident_trips.destination_rule: uniform among reachable distinct eligible endpoints of the selected class; partition exact counts before routing
resident_trips.return_trips: not represented in this first accounting benchmark

initial_road_loading.eligible_lanes: passenger-car permitted lanes, exclude duplicate/internal junction lane lengths
initial_road_loading.road_users: external through travelers, distinct from resident population
initial_road_loading.count_allocation: largest remainder with stable occupancy-category tie order; report realized fractions
initial_road_loading.placement: sample boundary-to-boundary reachable routes; sample feasible route progress weighted by length; reject overlaps/incompatible speed states rather than silently dropping actors

external_future_arrivals.occupancy_profile: same 0/1/2-person fractions as initial external vehicles; exact allocation by largest remainder
external_future_arrivals.gateway_rule: distinct reachable boundary gateway pairs; uniform choice among feasible pairs
external_future_arrivals.timing: uniform independent draws within each window at fixed counts
external_future_arrivals.relationship_to_residents: separate external population; never add these passengers to resident household totals

vehicle_service.resident_request_service: one distinct prepositioned autonomous vehicle per resident party; no pickup leg modeled
vehicle_service.vehicle_availability: preposition resident service vehicles at selected household origins; preserve parked state and do not count parked supply as initial road occupancy

scope_limits: hypothetical vehicle-network accounting benchmark, not an estimate of Coronado population or demand
